document_tenant_isolation.name: document_tenant_isolation
document_tenant_isolation.using:
coalesce(current_setting('app.system_role', true) = 'superadmin', false)
        or (nullif(current_setting('app.person_id', true), '')::integer is not null and "document"."organization_id" is null)
        or "document"."organization_id" in (select app_acting_organizations())

document_global_update_superadmin_only.name: document_global_update_superadmin_only
document_global_update_superadmin_only.using: coalesce(current_setting('app.system_role', true) = 'superadmin', false) or "document"."organization_id" is not null

document_global_delete_superadmin_only.name: document_global_delete_superadmin_only
document_global_delete_superadmin_only.using: coalesce(current_setting('app.system_role', true) = 'superadmin', false) or "document"."organization_id" is not null

person_shared_organization_or_self.name: person_shared_organization_or_self
person_shared_organization_or_self.using:
coalesce(current_setting('app.system_role', true) = 'superadmin', false) or "person"."id" = nullif(current_setting('app.person_id', true), '')::integer
        or exists (select 1 from public.membership m
                   where m.person_id = "person"."id"
                     and m.organization_id in (select app_acting_organizations()))
